name: Aethel

experience.motif: Evolving ink-and-watercolor illustrations on digital parchment

eyebrow: A Lifelong, Adaptive Companion for a Mind in the Making
headline: The Illustrated Primer, Realized.
subheadline: An AI-powered adaptive learning platform that begins as a devoted reading tutor and grows into a lifelong intellectual companion for every child.

googleCapabilities.label: Socratic Primer Engine
googleCapabilities.rationale: Generates personalized, Socratic-style narrative lessons and adaptive dialogue paths based on a child's unique curiosity, age, and moral reasoning level.

config.assistantRole: An elegant, Socratic tutor inspired by Neal Stephenson's Primer. You speak with intellectual warmth, using rich storytelling, gentle questioning, and neo-Victorian grace to guide a child's reasoning.
config.speechPrompt: Read the Socratic response aloud in a warm, comforting tone

screens.label: The Primer Sandbox
screens.title: Dialogue with the Primer
screens.description: Engage directly with Aethel's Socratic engine. Input a spark of curiosity to see how the Primer weaves it into a tailored lesson of logic, character, and discovery.

items.title: The Mystery of the Pendulum
items.detail: A story about Galileo, gravity, and the courage to question established dogmas.

items.title: Ink-and-Watercolor Canvas
items.detail: A digital parchment illustration of a swinging brass pendulum inside a cathedral, shifting dynamically with the story's progress.

screens.label: Configure Path
screens.title: Inscribe a New Chapter
screens.description: Set the coordinates for your child's next intellectual adventure. Aethel will synthesize these inputs into a bespoke, multi-day narrative curriculum.

items.title: Draft Chapter: The Clockwork Heavens
items.detail: Awaiting Socratic synthesis. Focuses on celestial motion and empirical observation.

items.title: Selected Virtue: Empirical Rigor
items.detail: Will guide the child to question dogmatic assumptions about the night sky.

screens.label: The Evolving Ledger
screens.title: A Mind in the Making
screens.description: A chronological record of your child's intellectual growth, moral reasoning milestones, and shared dialogues with Aethel.

items.title: Socratic Dialogue on Justice
items.detail: Discussed fairness using the story of the shared harvest. Child prioritized equity over raw division.

items.title: The Concept of Zero
items.detail: Explored the history of nothingness through ancient Indian mathematics. Demonstrated high abstract reasoning.

items.title: Phonics: The Silent 'E'
items.detail: Mastered the magic 'e' rule through a custom fable about a silent wizard who transforms words.

workflow.title: Inscribe a New Chapter
workflow.description: Configure the adaptive parameters for your child's next Socratic learning arc.

fields.label: Child's Name & Age
fields.placeholder: e.g., Victoria, Age 8, curious about the clockwork of the heavens

fields.label: Core Spark of Curiosity
fields.placeholder: e.g., Why do the stars twinkle, or how do the gears of a pocketwatch turn?

fields.label: Primary Intellectual Virtue Focus
options: Socratic Humility (Embracing what we do not know)
Ethical Responsibility (The impact of our choices)

workflow.successMessage: Aethel has synthesized a 5-part narrative arc blending astronomy with the history of scientific courage. The first dialogue is ready in the Sandbox.
